issues.title: Edit templates in admin pages
issues.body:
Initially, templates were stored in their own database file, and referred to from channel descriptions.

Our current strategy is to store templates inside the wargame that uses them.

So, we should modify the `admin` pages so that there is a `templates` tab inside the editor for a specific wargame.
